title: Best Response
body_html:
Best Response

For $\epsilon\ge 0$, the $\epsilon$-best response correspondence of player $i$ is $$ BR_i^\epsilon(s_{-i}) = \{s_i\in S_i: g_i(s_i,s_{-i})\ge g_i(t_i,s_{-i})-\epsilon \text{ for all } t_i\in S_i\}. $$ The ordinary best-response correspondence is $BR_i=BR_i^0$.

In a finite game, MFoGT also extends best response to mixed strategies against correlated strategies of the opponents: $$ BR_i(\theta_{-i}) = \{m_i\in\Delta(S_i): g_i(m_i,\theta_{-i})\ge g_i(\sigma_i,\theta_{-i}) \text{ for all } \sigma_i\in\Delta(S_i)\}. $$

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 1.3.4] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MathFoundationsGameTheory.pdf. epsilon-best response correspondence BR_i^epsilon.
  • [MFoGT, Def. 4.3.1] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MathFoundationsGameTheory.pdf. General best response correspondence against correlated strategies.
